title: Weight-Space Programming: A Survey and Roadmap
description: A survey of weight-space programming (WSP), in which a model, usually a large language model, reads, writes or edits the weights of a neural network directly, without an optimizer authoring the values. Covers 93 studies posted up to November 25, 2026, with a four-axis taxonomy, lineage, a reliability agenda, conditions for recursive self-improvement and eleven open problems. Includes the reading notes, corpus and generator scripts.
